# ML DSA Composite key generation test vectors.
# Source: https://github.com/lamps-wg/draft-composite-sigs/blob/main/src/testvectors.json
#
# Each stanza derives the ml dsa composite key pair from the IETF sk bytes
# (mldsaSeed || tradSK) and verifies that the resulting pub/priv match.
#
# ECDSA composites only; see the _rsa file for the other family.

# --- ML-DSA-44-ECDSA-P256-SHA256 ---
KeyGen = ML-DSA-44-ECDSA-P256-SHA256
KeyName = keygen_MLDSA44_ECDSA_P256_SHA256
Ctrl = hexpriv:C73679C3FE307C7AA1EA2FBD47E401434005B2D35A5A2734CF641EA2A9CBDEC530310201010420B94E7609A7176ABAFBD4A34FABAE42B091E44D9E46E67FCA566C2A188A63C65FA00A06082A8648CE3D030107
CtrlOut = hexpub:
CtrlOut = hexpriv:C73679C3FE307C7AA1EA2FBD47E401434005B2D35A5A2734CF641EA2A9CBDEC530310201010420B94E7609A7176ABAFBD4A34FABAE42B091E44D9E46E67FCA566C2A188A63C65FA00A06082A8648CE3D030107
